tagline: Reboot without losing your Claude Code sessions in Warp.
summary: Warp reopens its windows after a restart, but not the agents that ran in them. warp-session-restore remembers which Claude Code session ran in which pane, and after a reboot reopens the same windows, tab groups, colors and splits with every session resumed where it was.
capabilities: Snapshots Warp's layout from its own state database on every Claude Code turn end: windows, tab groups (name, color, collapsed, pinned), tab colors, nested pane splits, the focused pane
Matches each running Claude Code session to its Warp pane, with the launch flags worth replaying (remote control, permission mode, model, effort, extra dirs)
Restores the layout as a Warp launch configuration, each Claude pane running claude --resume in place: same session id, same Remote Control entry
Waits until every resumed session runs again, and says which did not
Restores only the tabs of the sessions you name, or previews the configuration with --dry-run
Checks that Warp's Claude Code plugin (agent notifications) is enabled
